description: Second E2E memory dataset. Focus: CRUD coverage across all six block types with diverse conversation content. English. One user, 17 conversations run in seq order. Complements e2e_memory_trajectory.json, which focuses on trigger mechanics.

persona.name: Sarah
persona.arc: Product Designer at a fintech -> promoted to Senior -> relocates twice -> ships one project, kills another, starts a third -> swaps her tool stack -> completes one goal and reverses one preference
persona.why: Deliberately different domain from dataset #1 (QA engineer) so the two datasets do not share vocabulary or failure modes.

test_user._only_one_user: All 17 conversations run on ONE user in seq order. Long-term memory is cross-conversation, so accumulation requires a single user.
test_user.requirement: Must be a NEW user with no memory. Verify first: open a 2-turn conversation and ask 'what do you know about me?' — the bot must know nothing.

rules.turn_definition: 1 turn = 1 user message + 1 assistant reply. 10 turns = 20 messages.
rules.trigger: T1 only (summary_completed). >= 10 turns in a conversation triggers both short-term summary and long-term extraction.
rules.T2_session_ended: NOT enabled. Conversations under 10 turns never write.
rules.read_write_asymmetry: READ: available from turn 1 of any new conversation. WRITE: only at >= 10 turns.
rules.turns_format: turns[] holds ONLY user messages. Assistant replies come from the live model. Turns with a 'verify' field must have their reply checked against expected_answer / expected_facts / must_not_contain.
rules.cooldown: lock:ltm:{user_id} TTL 10 min blocks only the NEXT trigger. Read-only conversations (<10 turns) run inside the gap.

user_profile.REMOVE: n/a — scalars are overwritten, not deleted

activities.REMOVE: S8 (abandoned, W=0.0, must drop from top-3)

behavior_pattern.EXPECTED: block stays EMPTY — needs >=7-day spread plus the weekly W10 job

GATE_1_list_removal.question: Can a user remove a skill by asking? Doc 2.5 says list merge is SET UNION — append-only, no removal path.
GATE_1_list_removal.scenario_B: Sketch stays -> union-only. Users cannot verbally correct their own memory. PRODUCT GAP worth reporting.
GATE_1_list_removal.control: Framer and Storybook must be present either way. If absent, extraction failed and the gate result is meaningless.

GATE_2_preference_removal.question: Same removal question, different block. Completed goal and reversed avoidance must leave their lists.
GATE_2_preference_removal.why_it_matters: If capability removal fails but preference removal works, behaviour is inconsistent per block type.

GATE_3_abandoned_ranking.question: Does W(status)=0.0 keep an abandoned project out of Core LTM top-3?

GATE_4_field_cap.question: Is interests[] < 10 enforced, and what gets evicted?
GATE_4_field_cap.prior_evidence: A staging user was already observed with 12 interests, so the cap may not be enforced. This case confirms it.

GATE_5_intra_conv_conflict.question: Two explicit statements in one conversation — does the LAST win?
GATE_5_intra_conv_conflict.fail: 'Berlin' in memory means the extraction took the first mention.

GATE_6_behavior_conservatism.question: Does a behavior_pattern block appear from 3 SAME-DAY events, and if not immediately, does it appear after the weekly job runs?
GATE_6_behavior_conservatism.day_0_expected: EMPTY. Three events exist but spread = 0 days.
GATE_6_behavior_conservatism.day_8_reading_A: STILL EMPTY — spread is measured BETWEEN events, so it stays 0 forever. This matches doc 2.3 as written.
GATE_6_behavior_conservatism.day_8_reading_B: BLOCK APPEARS — spread is measured as elapsed time since the first signal. This lets one burst of same-day chatter become a 'pattern' a week later, which the conservative rule was meant to prevent. FINDING.
GATE_6_behavior_conservatism.prerequisite: Confirm the weekly W10 job actually ran in the gap. If it never ran, the result says nothing about the rule.

GATE_7_extended_ltm.question: Can a top_of_mind block that fell out of Core LTM top-3 still be retrieved by a targeted query?
GATE_7_extended_ltm.target: 'variable fonts' from S3 — roughly 8 newer topics were added after it
GATE_7_extended_ltm.pass: Recalled -> Extended LTM / vector search works.
GATE_7_extended_ltm.fail: Not recalled -> the block is in the DB but retrieval cannot reach it. Core LTM alone is not enough and Extended LTM is either not called or not matching.

execution.how: ONE user, run S1 -> S17 in order. After each triggering conversation, poll until memory changes, then wait 11 minutes before the next triggering conversation. Read-only conversations fill the gaps.
execution.snapshot: Save fetch_core_memory_v2 output to a file after EVERY conversation. There is no reset API — if a run fails midway you must start over with a fresh user, so snapshots are the only diagnostic record.
